mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of overall economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST shows sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% within a month, coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals strong consumer demand and a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 2% in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 2% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over three months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over six months signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, unless there is a concurrent significant increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3%).
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 1% in 6 months AND CPIAUCSL increases < 3% in 6 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases by more than 1% and CPIAUCSL increases by less than 3% over six months.
